summary: Lando Norris won the Monaco Grand Prix from pole position, 3.1s ahead of Charles Leclerc, with Oscar Piastri completing the podium.
Oliver Bearman made the biggest climb, from P20 to P12.
Yuki Tsunoda had a day to forget, dropping from P12 to P17.
The race was neutralised by 1 virtual safety car.
The stewards penalised RUS (drive through penalty).
There were 40 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Oscar Piastri leads the championship by 3 points over Lando Norris.
